post.description:
Re-issue an invite.

- Generates a fresh random password and updates auth.users.
- Emails the new password via Resend.
- Does NOT change role/org/quota.

Permissions:
- super_admin: may resend for anyone except themselves.
- admin:      may resend only for non-admin users in their own org.

post.description:
Streaming counterpart of ``POST /chat``.

Returns ``text/event-stream`` with a sequence of JSON-encoded SSE frames:

- ``{"event": "status", "phase": "guard"|"rag_search"|"synthesizing", ...}``
- ``{"event": "token",  "text": "..."}``
- ``{"event": "done",   "session_id", "status", "answer", "sources",
                        "attached_pages", "tool_calls_made", "meta"}``

The non-streaming ``POST /chat`` remains the canonical path; this
endpoint is additive.
post.summary: Chat with documents using RAG agent (SSE stream)
